question: What is the first name, country code, and birth date of the player with the most winner rank points across all matches?
gold_query: SELECT players.first_name , players.country_code , players.dob FROM players JOIN matches ON players.player_id = matches.winner_id ORDER BY matches.winner_rank_points desc LIMIT 1
